description: Reviewed CIE Lab colour mapping from Kenney CC0 kits (Nature Kit 2.1, Platformer Kit 4.1, Food Kit 2.0, Holiday Kit 2.0) to Guardiões da Mata Atlântica ART.md ramps (game/src/style/palette.ts).

leafsGreen.rationale: Tree canopies and palm fronds mapped from Kenney teal-green to Atlantic Forest mid-canopy leaf[2].

grass.rationale: Bushes, grass tufts, moss, and seedling leaves mapped to sunlit clearing grass[2].

woodBark.rationale: Tree trunks, logs, and stumps mapped from Kenney orange-brown to natural bark wood[1].

woodInner.rationale: Cut log rings and inner heartwood mapped to brightest wood[3].

wood.rationale: Planter pots, signboards, and split firewood mapped to warm timber wood[2].

woodBarkDark.rationale: Nursery pot rim and soil bed mapped to soil[2].

woodDark.rationale: Signpost support and charred campfire logs mapped to deep shadow wood[0].

dirt.rationale: In rock_largeA, Kenney named the boulder material 'dirt'; mapped to Atlantic Forest granite rock[1].

stone.rationale: Stones and boulders mapped to mid-light granite rock[2].

colorYellow.rationale: Yellow forest flowers mapped to ipê-amarelo botanical accent.

_defaultMat.rationale: Pure white #ffffff violates ART.md lightness max (0.90); mapped to light stone/plaque rock[3].

(7,2).rationale: Obby grass block tops mapped to the 4-step grass ramp (light to shadow).

(3,2).rationale: Obby wooden planks and soil sides mapped to the 4-step wood ramp.

(4,2).rationale: Obby platform structural beams and earth sub-base mapped to soil/wood shadow steps.

(0,1).rationale: Interactive collectible coin-gold uses reserved accent.gold (#ffd166) per ART.md §2.

(2,1).rationale: Interactive obby checkpoint flag banner uses reserved accent.gold (#ffd166) per ART.md §2.

(7,3).rationale: Checkpoint flag mast and stone base mapped to rock ramp.

(2,2).rationale: Flag trim and light stone accents mapped to rock[3..1] (avoiding pure white).

(7,2).rationale: Plastic PET bottle & soda can body mapped to translucent-look water blue ramp.

(1,2).rationale: Bottle cap & neck ring mapped to leaf green ramp.

(4,3).rationale: Aluminum can metallic rim mapped to rock grey ramp.

(6,3).rationale: Aluminum can top/bottom mapped to light rock[3..0] ramp.

(1,3).rationale: Can pull-tab opening mapped to darkest rock/wood shadow step.

(2,2).rationale: Discarded bag mapped to soil/kraft-paper ramp.

(1,2).rationale: Ranger station cabin walls, logs, doorway, and wood floor mapped to wood ramp.

(5,2).rationale: Ranger station cabin roof and window frames mapped to forest guard leaf green ramp.

(2,2).rationale: Cabin roof rafters and dark timber trim mapped to soil/wood shadow ramp.
